questions.prompt:

4, 7, 11, 18, 29, 47, ____
questions.explanation: Each term after the first two equals the sum of the preceding two terms; 29 + 47 = 76.

17, 25, 32, 37, 47, 58, ____

questions.prompt: A two-digit number has a tens digit of 6. Reversing its digits produces a number 27 less than the original. What is the original number?

questions.prompt: Which value of n makes 18 × 25 × n a perfect square?
